status: Written before any HoloCT answer on our cases was seen. Do not reword after looking at results on a set and then report on that set.
training_overlap_note: HoloCT was trained on the CT-RATE train split. All 70 of our CT-RATE validation patients are in HoloCT's published TEST split (holodata-v1) and none in its train split, so this is not a leak, but the model has seen 20,000 patients from the same hospital, scanners and report style.
question_template: Please answer with Yes or No: {q}
question_template_note: HoloCT's own 'binary' VQA template (utils/corpus/prompt_templates.py). The exact CT-RATE question wording used in its training is not released.

questions.q: Is there medical material (such as a device, catheter, wire, stent or surgical clip) in this CT scan?
Is there arterial wall calcification in this CT scan?
Is there cardiomegaly in this CT scan?
Is there pericardial effusion in this CT scan?
Is there coronary artery wall calcification in this CT scan?
Is there a hiatal hernia in this CT scan?
Is there lymphadenopathy in this CT scan?
Is there emphysema in this CT scan?
Is there atelectasis in this CT scan?
Is there a lung nodule in this CT scan?
Is there lung opacity in this CT scan?

Is there peribronchial thickening in this CT scan?

findings_prompt: Identify all abnormal findings in the lung, pleura, trachea and bronchi.
findings_grounded_prompt: Identify and segment all abnormal findings in the lung, pleura, trachea and bronchi.
findings_note: HoloCT's own ReXGrounding demo prompts and decoding (sampling, temperature 0.15, top-p 0.85, repetition penalty 1.15, max 1024 new tokens). Text and masks are saved for review; they are not scored.
